assumptions: TraceTuner's quality model and the calibration table named.
limits: Keeps the bases; only the qualities change.
bio.jane/contract.question: What Phred quality does each of this trace's calls earn, measured from its peaks?

description: Re-score a Sanger trace's own base calls from the signal, replacing the instrument's Phred values with ones measured from the peaks. Keeps the bases; only their quality changes. Reports the read's mean quality, its lowest-scoring base and the four trace parameters that base was scored from, which are the whole input to the quality table.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

document.description: which trace to run on: a file name (`read_F.ab1`) or its project file id. Leave unset to use the trace tab on screen. A file id is project-specific, so a template ships this unset.

table.description: the instrument/polymer calibration table to score against. The same signal scores differently under each, so a quality value is only interpretable with the table named. Defaults to ABI 3730 POP-7.

name: recompute_trace_quality

bases.description: how many bases the reading called

instrumentBases.description: how many the FILE carries, so a gate can see a de-novo reading change the read's length

meanQuality.description: the mean Phred of the reading, on the calibration table it names
